deck.name: planeswalkers
deck.summary:
Jace, Multiverse Architect leads a patient planeswalker deck built around empowered Jace tokens, shared loyalty abilities, and a protective creature army. Establish fixing first, then layer the Way enchantments with life gain and expendable tokens to keep loyalty growing. Win through Jace, Reality Sculptor's library-exile finish, Sanctum Lurker's repeated drain, or an army strengthened by planeswalker emblems; chief among the token engines is Ajani Unrelenting. The deck gives up explosive speed and a dense counterspell package for overlapping engines and a broader set-themed board. Three useful first pickups are Arcane Signet, Way of the Mentor, and Sanctum Lurker.

The quality model grades this deck at the precon baseline against the top lists of the format: few of the cards are ones the top lists of the format play, and that lowers the grade. Many of the cards appear in no top list, and that lowers the grade. The cards pair in ways the top lists do not, and that lowers the grade.
